# Vendored license texts

License files of projects whose crates are published without one, used by `../scripts/third_party_notices.py`
(`SAME_TEXTS_AS`, `vendored:` entries) when a binary artifact links those crates. Each file is the project's own
license file, copied unchanged; the entry names the repository it must match.

| File | Source | Crates |
|---|---|---|
| `napi-rs.LICENSE` | `LICENSE` of <https://github.com/napi-rs/napi-rs> at fe23eb08a52e4cfc87ca0f3475907bea78f46d7e | napi, napi-sys, napi-derive, napi-derive-backend |
